title: Champ-ray targets Japan drone market with power modules
snippet: Champ-Ray Industrial is stepping up efforts to expand in Japan's drone market, using a recent sponsorship tie-in with the Oita Trinita professional football team in Japan's J2 League to open deeper exchanges with the Oita Prefectural Government and local drone operators. The DC motor and ceiling fan maker said it is mapping local drone industry needs and evaluating whether to submit samples for testing as it moves toward practical cooperation.

title: Machvision expands early to chase NT$10B revenue
snippet: Machvision is expanding capacity earlier than planned to meet rising demand from semiconductors, substrates, and optical modules, while tight computer numerical control (CNC) and machining supply chains have emerged as its biggest operating challenge. The inspection equipment maker is reshaping its Hsinchu and Kunshan facilities and expects the new footprint to support NT$10 billion (US$313.03 million) in revenue starting in 2027.

title: Samsung's mobile unit faces more than KRW1 trillion loss as memory costs surge
snippet: Samsung Electronics is expected to report another operating loss at its Mobile eXperience and network business in the third quarter of 2026, even as strong Galaxy Z foldable sales support handset demand. The preliminary earnings release is due in early October 2026, with the pressure coming from sharply higher memory prices and limited ability to raise device prices.

title: GM begins U.S. battery cell trial runs with South Korean equipment
